FQHESphereWithSU2SpinLLLProjectedLLLTimesManyLL, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSU2SpinLLLProjectedLLLTimesManyLL [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)

    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (default value = 0)
    --lambda-state : provide a many-body state for the lambda levels, instead of using filled lambda levels
    --disable-szsymmetry : disable the Sz<->-Sz symmetry for the Sz=0 sector
    --disable-lzsymmetry : disable the Lz<->-Lz symmetry for the Lz=0 sector
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    -r, --aspect-ratio : aspect ratio of the cylinder (default value = 1)
    --cylinder-perimeter : if non zero, fix the cylinder perimeter (in magnetic length unit) instead of the aspect ratio (default value = 0)

output options:
    --normalize : normalize the projected state assuming the sphere geometry
    --cylinder-normalize : normalize the projected state assuming the cylinder geometry
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --interaction-name : interaction name (as it should appear in output files)
    --outputvector-index : set the index of the output vector (i.e. the integer in the extention *.xxx.vec) (default value = 0)
